items.title: New Gar Record Set In Surprising State
items.summary: A Minnesota angler landed a fish that is now listed among the state’s most impressive catches. Alejanaro Garcia of Richfield, Minnesota, caught a massive 54-inch longnose gar from the Mississippi River in Winona County on Sept. 6, 2026, setting a new Minnesota state catch-and-release record.
